title: Swallow's Nest
description: The Swallow's Nest is located in the urban-type settlement of Gaspra in the Autonomous Republic of Crimea. It is also called – the castle of Baron von Steingel, in honour of one of its first owners, a famous oilman. The estate later became the property of the Rakhmanov family. In 1912, the architect Leonid Sherwood completed a reconstruction of the building so that it resembled a neo-Gothic castle. This is how the Swallow's Nest looks like today.
